Two of Jewett's three lines for the year would then come off two facing pages of one letter to Willa Cather. Nothing in the rules forbids it, but if a second Jewett is wanted elsewhere in the year this is the place to spend the decision. If it does ship, match the March source line's form, which is shorter and keeps the two cards consistent.
